states.web: Idle shows the mic icon with the default variant and the name Start dictation; listening shows the stop square with the destructive variant and the name Stop dictation; processing shows a Spinner, the name Transcribing, and a disabled button. A refused microphone or a recorder error returns the button to idle without a message.

interaction.web: A press toggles: on the Web Speech path it starts and stops a continuous recogniser with interim results and reports final transcripts only; on the recorder path it opens getUserMedia (with deviceId exact when set), records, and on stop sends the webm blob to onAudioRecorded and passes the returned text to onTranscriptionChange. preferMediaRecorder chooses the recorder even where SpeechRecognition exists. Tracks and recognisers are stopped on unmount.

semantics.web: A single button whose aria-label follows its state (Start dictation, Stop dictation, Transcribing); there is deliberately no aria-pressed, because the label already names the next action; recording is conveyed by the variant, the icon and the label, not by colour alone.
